description: This file defines an interface class IPluginStarter for starting plugins, specifically Thunder plugins. It declares a virtual destructor and a pure virtual method activatePlugin which attempts to activate a plugin with retries.

classes.name: IPluginStarter
classes.description: Interface to start a specified plugin, capable of asynchronously activating Thunder plugins with retries.

methods.name: activatePlugin
methods.description: Attempts to activate a Thunder plugin with specified maximum retries and delay between retries.
